en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad and Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Musa Al Khashaab, from one of his men, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that he<sup>asws</sup>

was asked about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [20:5] The Beneficent is Even upon the Throne. So heasws said: ‘Even upon everything. So there isn’t anything more closer to Himazwj than a (another) thing’.
